label: Action List menu item
summary: "Action List" menu item in the Kuali Build nav.

label: Action List document link (by doc number)
summary: Document link matching a doc number EXACTLY (anchored regex); clicks .first() because both Document# and Document Title columns expose the number.
note: Parameterized selector — takes docNumber string; anchored regex /^\s*<n>\s*$/ prevents substring collisions. Click .first() since two columns repeat the number.

label: All pending document links in the Action List
summary: Enumerates every bare-number link in the Action List (one per pending document row) for reading the full set of pending doc numbers.
note: NEEDS LIVE VERIFICATION — derived from docLink pattern; not yet confirmed against a live Action List. Read-only; never opens or mutates a document.

label: Action List search box (fill)
summary: Textbox for filtering the Action List by document number; scoped to the .kp-input-group containing the GO button.
note: Scoped to `.kp-input-group:has(.kp-input-button-right)` to avoid matching the global nav Search textbox (top-right, no GO button). Kuali search is substring-based.

label: Action List search box (scrape)
summary: Read current filter value from the Action List search textbox.

label: Action List search GO button
summary: Submits the Action List search filter; the only "GO" button on the page.

label: Navbar Save button
summary: Save button with a 3-deep fallback chain: action-bar Save → nav Save → generic role Save.
note: 3-deep .or() chain: [class*="action-bar"] button:has-text("Save") → nav button:has-text("Save") → getByRole("button", {name:"Save", exact:true}). fillTransactionResults does NOT save — call clickSave() separately.
